title: 长脖子够得到树顶
subtitle: 脖子里有十五块骨头
character: wearing a pale blue t-shirt, brown shorts and white sneakers, short black hair
style: children's picture book illustration, soft coloured pencil drawing with light hatching, forest green, warm brown and pale sky blue

pages.zh:
院子里的果子
长得太高了。
我踮起脚，
伸直胳膊，
还是够不到。
pages.scene: The little boy in a garden reaching up with one arm towards fruit on a branch, seen from close in front so his face is large in the frame and turned towards the viewer, both eyes clearly drawn with white, a dark round iris and a small bright highlight, his mouth set with effort, up on his toes.

pages.zh:
有一种恐龙，
脖子特别长。
比一辆公交车还长，
站在地上
就能吃到三楼的叶子。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: one long-necked dinosaur silhouette on a cream background standing beside the outline of a three-storey building, its head level with the top floor. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
脖子这么长，
里面有多少块骨头？
十五块。
我们的脖子里
只有七块。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: two neck outlines side by side on a cream background, the long one divided into fifteen blocks and the short one into seven blocks. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
脖子长有个好处：
不用走来走去。
站在一个地方，
脖子转一圈，
周围的叶子都吃得到。
pages.scene: One long-necked dinosaur standing still among several trees on a cream background, its head turned to one side reaching leaves. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
它的头却很小，
和身体比起来
小得不像话。
头要是太重，
脖子就抬不起来了。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: one long-necked dinosaur silhouette on a cream background with a circle drawn around its very small head. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
它的牙像一排耙子，
只管把叶子捋下来，
不嚼，
直接吞下去。
嚼太费时间了。
pages.scene: One long-necked dinosaur head seen in profile close up on a cream background, its mouth open to show a single even row of blunt peg-shaped teeth all the same length, closing around a leafy branch.

pages.zh:
不嚼怎么消化呢？
它吞石头。
石头在肚子里
滚来滚去把叶子磨碎，
代替牙齿干活。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: one stomach outline on a cream background with leaves and several round smooth stones inside it. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
它一天
要吃好几百公斤叶子。
吃完这一棵，
就慢慢走到下一棵，
一天到晚都在吃。
pages.scene: One long-necked dinosaur walking slowly from one tree to another on a cream background. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
血要从心脏
一直送到头上去，
那么高。
所以它的心脏
特别大，特别有力气。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: one long-necked dinosaur body outline on a cream background with a heart marked in the chest and one arrow running all the way up the neck to the head. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
它的尾巴也很长，
甩起来像一条鞭子。
啪的一声，
谁都不敢
靠得太近。
pages.scene: One long-necked dinosaur swinging its long tail on a cream background, motion lines behind the tail tip. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
脖子往前伸，
尾巴往后伸，
中间搭在四条腿上。
整个身体
就像一座桥，稳稳的。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: one long-necked dinosaur seen from the side on a cream background with its neck and tail drawn as the two arms of a bridge and its legs as the bridge supports. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
爸爸把我举起来，
我一伸手
就够到了那个果子。
原来长脖子
是这种感觉。
pages.scene: The father lifts the little boy on his shoulders in the garden; the boy is close to the viewer with his face large in the frame and turned towards the viewer, delighted, both eyes clearly drawn with white, a dark round iris and a small bright highlight, one hand closing around the fruit.
